timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,488–1,490 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is currently WEAK (high KRW per USD), making dollars expensive for your monthly $2,000 conversion. News indicates the rate is rising toward 1,490 and expected to climb further due to Middle East tensions and semiconductor sector weakness, so timing your purchase now locks in an unfavorable rate.

TIP: Consider spreading your $2,000 monthly purchase across multiple smaller transactions, or wait for any temporary dips below 1,480 KRW/USD if your budget allows, since the trend suggests rates may rise further in the near term.
